liveDrillRequirements: Choose an isolated staging Make scenario and hook, with staging-only provider credentials.
Capture staging and production release, blueprint and settings; declare only exact intentional environment differences.
Connect authoritative running-execution counts to the queue adapter; missing counts block deletion.
Save and decrypt-check the intake journal copy before any queue cleanup.
Read both exact queue items; stop processors; confirm exactly one candidate and one survivor.
Collect fresh exhaustive CRM, Twilio, Vapi, billing, charges and delivered-SMS evidence using authenticated provider readers.
Run both automatic duplicate prevention and separate guarded manual cleanup drills.
After deployment, run one controlled production smoke test; staging success alone is not production proof.
safetyNotes: Queue deletion is staging-only, exact-item-only and locked per event. Never automatically retry an uncertain deletion.
Paid provider retries cannot blindly create replacements when reconciliation finds no resource.
Provider inventories must be complete; capped or malformed Vapi responses block reconciliation.
Current SMS/billing replay tests use simulated side effects, not live delivery or charge evidence.
Journal payloads are encrypted and cannot be replayed after 30 days. Physical retention cleanup must be configured separately.
Accepted webhook responses do not mean signup ready. Existing verification and delivery gates remain required.
Make MCP is not connected in this session; the queue adapter uses the documented Make API.

researchedServices.limitations: At-least-once delivery; duplicates and out-of-order events possible; no latency SLA. Does not establish a recharge receipt integration.
